purpose: Integrate saved research and explicit rejection gates; not automated strategy discovery.
markets: Binance Spot only; no leverage, prediction markets or real orders
current_data_status: Previously inspected historical sample; all imported hypotheses remain exploratory
scout: Import fixed allowlisted research files; optionally collect timestamped official Fed/ECB RSS snapshots. No X or13F ingestion.
quant: Optionally replay exactly two frozen hourly hypotheses; evaluate three existing evidence sets with explicit failure gates
builder: Do not promote or generate a winning deployment when independent evidence is absent
scoring: Do not invent 1-5 OOS scores for in-sample or previously inspected data. Score remains null.
required_positive_blocks: at least3 of4, plus positive doubled-cost stress and untouched OOS
multiple_testing: Record every imported hypothesis and rerun; do not count reruns as new independent evidence
monte_carlo: Existing IID cashflow bootstrap is not a complete drawdown simulation or independent validation
